summary.headline: IIFL Capital Q1 FY27 revenue flat at INR631 crore; distribution income fell 31% QoQ while institutional/IB rose 27% to INR207 crore.
summary.overview: Consolidated operational revenue was INR631 crore, flat QoQ and YoY. Retail broking revenue was flat QoQ at INR297 crore, while institutional broking and IB income rose 27% QoQ to INR207 crore. Financial product distribution fell about 31% QoQ to INR125 crore, which management attributed to the seasonal Q4 insurance peak and lumpy transactional income booked in Q4. Operational PBT was INR149 crore, up 4% QoQ but down about 9% YoY; other income jumped to about INR90 crore on mark-to-market gains on BSE shares.

segments.name: Retail broking
segments.commentary: Revenue INR297 crore, flat QoQ and up 13% YoY from INR264 crore. Few RMs added in the quarter (single-digit, per management).

segments.name: Institutional broking and investment banking
segments.commentary: Combined revenue INR207 crore, up 27% QoQ. Institutional equities roughly INR200 crore combined with IB; split roughly 50:50 or 60:40 by management.

segments.name: Financial product distribution
segments.commentary: Income INR125 crore, down about 31% QoQ and 14% YoY, due to absence of Q4 insurance peak and lower lumpy transactional income. Implied yield fell to about 87 bps; management said product-level yields were unchanged and the drop reflects non-ARR income mix. Includes income on AIF and PMS AUM of about INR4,400 crore.

guidance_outlook: Management expects AUM growth to catch up next quarter after a slower Q1 in net collections of about INR3,675 crore.
Fairfax transaction: approvals from SEBI, NSE, BSE and IRDAI in process; management expects completion in roughly 2-3 months. Fairfax to become promoter with right to nominate two directors.
Management said impact of 1 July margin rules (RBI/SEBI margin requirements) has been marginal so far; not expected to affect volumes in Q1, but may have impact over time.
capex_capacity: Company has started AIF and PMS businesses, has one credit fund and one late-stage fund, as part of an in-house product manufacturing plan while keeping open architecture.
Preferential issue of equity at INR350 per share, about INR2,000 crore, approved by shareholders at EGM on 1 June 2026; no funds received yet.
demand_pricing: Average daily turnover fell about 2% QoQ to INR3,15,780 crore, with F&O at INR3,12,480 crore and cash at INR3,300 crore.
Company is not a proprietary trader and has few such clients, so the margin-rule change has had limited impact to date.
Distribution yield decline attributed to non-ARR (brokerage and insurance) income mix rather than product-level pricing changes.

qa_highlights.question: How much AUM growth was organic and why was it slower than peers this quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited net collections of about INR3,675 crore in the quarter and said Q1 may be a one-off, with catch-up expected from next quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Has the Fairfax INR2,000 crore been received and what is the fallback if the deal fails?
qa_highlights.answer: Funds have not been received; approvals are in process and preferential allotment will follow approvals, expected in 2-3 months. No fallback was discussed.

qa_highlights.question: What is the implied distribution yield decline to about 87 bps?
qa_highlights.answer: Lower FPD income from absence of Q4 insurance and some brokerage income in Q1 reduced yield; product-wise yields unchanged, with a higher non-ARR mix last quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Impact of 1 July margin rule changes on broking?
qa_highlights.answer: Marginal impact so far; not expected to affect volumes or turnover in Q1 but may matter over time.

qa_highlights.question: Split between institutional broking and IB income?
qa_highlights.answer: Combined about INR200 crore; split roughly 50:50 or 60:40, per management.

qa_highlights.question: Plans for AIF and PMS business with AUM around INR4,400 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Income is booked under financial product distribution; company is building in-house manufacturing (AIF, PMS, credit fund, late-stage fund) while retaining open architecture.

risks_watch: Fairfax transaction completion (about INR2,000 crore at INR350/share plus mandatory open offer) depends on SEBI, NSE, BSE and IRDAI approvals.
Income tax demand of INR124 crore from the January 2025 Section 132 search on holding company and subsidiaries; under appeal.
Margin rule changes from 1 July may affect broking volumes over time; too early to quantify.
Volatile macro backdrop, with crude near $100 a barrel and geopolitical uncertainty affecting flows.
Distribution income remains lumpy and seasonal (insurance); other income depends on BSE share MTM.
summary.management_tone: Cautious on the macro and regulatory outlook but confident on the Fairfax strategic rationale. Management was candid on the QoQ decline in distribution income and gave rough, non-precise figures on institutional and IB splits and RM additions.
